// diagnostic E2721

Jet.GrammarTooComplex

This grammar decision needs too much lookahead to check

What

This grammar decision needs too much lookahead to check

Why

The build searches the tokens that can come next at one decision only up to a fixed number of token sequences, so that checking a grammar stays fast.

Fix

Factor the alternatives so that their first tokens tell them apart.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GrammarTooComplex: Tests/UI/grammar_too_complex.stderr.

Error: Jet.GrammarTooComplex: In `pick`, the lookahead at this decision passed 4096 token sequences
  --> Tests/UI/grammar_too_complex.jet:6:12
    |
  6 |     pick : word 'x' # X | word 'y' # Y ;
    |            ^
 Why: The build searches the tokens that can come next at one decision only up to a fixed number of token sequences, so that checking a grammar stays fast
 Fix: Factor the alternatives so that their first tokens tell them apart
